title: Top Corner
synopsis: An Si-Jun, a math genius boy with a dream of becoming a novelist, coincidentally meets Heo Do-Hyeong, a promising player on the Gwangjin High School soccer team. Do-Hyeong discovers Si-Jun's latent soccer talent through an unexpected incident. In order to save the team, he proposes a secret deal to Si-Jun, but... "... I've never played soccer before..?" Will Si-Jun be able to become the savior of the Gwangjin High School soccer team in crisis? A soccer drama about boys chasing their dreams. The kickoff of the math genius begins! (Source: Naver, translated)

synopsis: Sharks don't have lungs, but they do have to breathe oxygen to survive. Instead of breathing air, though, sharks get oxygen from the water that surrounds them. title: Aoku Somero
synonyms: Dye Blue, Even If You Die
synopsis: The older brother was a genius. At just 15 years old, he was already receiving offers from top teams around the world — a true “treasure of Japanese soccer.” Would it be Madrid or Barcelona? Or perhaps a prestigious club in England? The entire country was watching with anticipation to see where he would go. But the young prodigy made a surprising choice: he decided to attend “a Japanese high school where his underachieving younger brother would be enrolling.” “Because there’s someone amazing there that I want to play with!” With the “genius older brother” and the “underachieving younger brother,” let them stir up a storm in the world of soccer! (Source: Magazine pocket)

title: Jueshi Zhan Hun
synopsis: In Jang Lin, the martial arts path cannot be walked for those who cannot awaken the martial spirit. In this world, only those who have a strong fighting spirit can communicate with the heavens and the earth. Born in Linshui, Chen Nan was an unparalleled genius with talent and thought he would become a great fighter in the future. However, Chen Nan was struck by lightning rays while practicing his martial arts and obtaining the spirit of divine battle, which was able to settle. To break the ultimate rule of Jang Lin, Qin Nan didn’t know that his fighting spirit possessed a great secret that would slowly discover mystery as the story continued.

title: Napoleon: Era of the lion
titleNative: ナポレオン ─獅子の時代─
synopsis: This is a story of the life of Napoleon. The tale begins just before the Battle of Austerlitz. Then, it jumps back to 1769 to tell the story of Napoleon's life from the very beginning, including the circumstances of his birth, his childhood on Corsica, and his difficulties as a Corsican boy in a French school. All of these experiences eventually culminate in his becoming the famous Emperor of the French.

synopsis: Kitami, a boy serving as class representative, is struggling to get a girl named Toujou — who transferred into the class in the middle of the semester — to fit in better with the class. Kitami desperately tries to stand up for her, but he gradually becomes isolated... (Source: Gangan Online, translated)
